findings.evidence: Sections 7-13 split lifecycle fault cuts by resource/member, distinguish syscall errors from forced process termination, record frame/catalog/inventory/identity/error/poison/counter oracles, and define each cleanup and close resource outcome.

Per-stage create/write/Sync/identity results use stable errors and restart outcomes; db_open_app and db_open_recovery are separate; close state is classified as closed/still_open/unknown with retry ownership and lock retention.
C1-C5 named IPC schedules and bounded concurrency assertions remain present.
Native Linux and Windows runner evidence and fail-on-skip requirements remain present.
E2E-PILOT-01..07 mapping remains present and supervisor tests remain explicitly insufficient for classroom acceptance.
Coverage, adapter, structured observability, trace, and negative-log-scan requirements remain present.
Case IDs are consistently 16-byte/128-bit and 32 lowercase hex.
SQLite canonical-path-only check and trusted private directory boundary are consistent; no OS handle identity proof is claimed.

note: Generation zero is only the absent/no-record sentinel; valid persisted catalog records start at one. This is a design review PASS only, not implementation or E2E test evidence.
